assets.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. ONE exact 3×3 atlas, nine independent square cells with ivory gutters at the exact thirds, no overlap. Original first-grade Chinese picture book, soft matte gouache, clean cut-paper silhouettes and fine paper grain, quiet deep pine, warm cream, apricot and persimmon, no text/numbers/symbols/labels/watermarks, no textbook drawings. Clear iconic composition at 60 pixels. The same kind East Asian 7-year-old girl with short black bob and cream-collared orange coat appears in the two child tiles. Top row left to right: (1) calm brown-and-white cow with black nose, side view, whole animal on cream ground; (2) fluffy white sheep with dark face and four visible feet on cream ground; (3) close view of a cat's outstretched paw showing clearly curved claws at the tips (no injury or people, claws visible), cream ground. Middle row: (4) an orange half-sun just lifting over a low blue-gray horizon at dawn, sky goes from lavender to apricot, no weather writing; (5) two small hands slide two bright geometric blocks together to complete a four-square pattern on cream tabletop, strong visual meaning of assembling, no jigsaw texture; (6) a bronze handbell tilted as it rings, two small contrasting sound arcs around it but no letters or music symbols, warm cream field. Bottom row: (7) girl host looks up and offers a blank peach greeting card with both hands to her gray-haired grandma sitting by the window; (8) same girl host offers a blank peach greeting card to a same-aged East Asian schoolmate in pine green, both look at each other and smile, community exhibit; (9) a small pine-green wooden toy skiff with wide shallow hull, two eye-like round highlights painted at its bow but no face or text, side view, centered on plain warm cream background with no landscape or people, fit entirely inside cell. No red printed signs. Keep action and object centers within each cell without cropped subjects.
